entities.name: Haaach
entities.description: A criminal goblin berserker from Alara, wanted on Naya, last seen at the Battle of the Bloody Gate.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: Shard of Alara where Haaach became wanted.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: Shard whose war laws Haaach violated.

entities.name: Bloodhall
entities.description: Jund cavern system where Haaach's goblin warren originates.

entities.name: Nacatl prides
entities.description: Posted a bounty for the ceremonial dagger's return.

entities.name: Battle of the Bloody Gate
entities.description: Battle in Valeron where Haaach is believed killed.

entities.name: Valeron
entities.description: Site of the Battle of the Bloody Gate.

events.summary: Haaach obtains an ancient ceremonial dagger on Naya and the Nacatl prides post a bounty for its return.
events.quote: In response, the Nacatl prides posted a bounty for its safe return.

events.summary: Haaach is last seen at the Battle of the Bloody Gate, where he is believed killed.
events.quote: He was last seen at the Battle of the Bloody Gate in Valeron , where he is believed to have been killed
